notes.title: Fixes
notes.content:
- The game no longer crashes when trying to access the leaderboards
- Improved the leaderboards ergonomy to avoid displaying all entries at once. There is now a page system, which displays up to 15 entries.
- Added some optimizations on leaderboard, which should prevent any freeze to happen
- Finishing a level should now unlock it permanently in the level selection screen


We are aware of the performance issues you might encounter, especially in the disctrict 2, however performance improvements are very unlikely to happen since it would require a lot of additional work, and probably a full pass on all the levels, which is not feasible for us right now.

notes.title: Aefen Fall update
notes.content:
Here's a list of the changes :

Options

Options were not correctly saved when pressing the return button
Added an option to disable/enable the subtitles
Added an option to disable/enable V-Sync
Fixed navigation problems in the options
Checkboxes are now easily clickable with mouse or gamepad

We also worked on a resolution option, that would allow the players to change the resolution of the game, but the game became very unstable and we experienced a lot of crashes when changing the resolution. That's why we decided to remove this option, since we were not able to overcome the issue. Sorry for the inconvenience.

Stats

Some achievements were not unlocking correctly (or sometimes too easy to unlock)
Fixed a bug that was preventing the stats from being saved correctly, causing some achievements to be nearly impossible to unlock
Fixed score being sent twice to the leaderboard


Localization

Fixed french localizations of the alchemical titles
Added a few missing french localizations


Collisions

Fixed many collision problems in different levels
